result.encoder_chain: Ghostscript jpeg device (400 dpi, 4:2:0, Artifex sRGB ICC) THEN ImageMagick re-encode at IJG quality 92 with optimised Huffman coding
result.ghostscript_bound: The LP2 profile's PCS-illuminant bytes (offset 68..79) are 0000f6d5 00010000 0000d32c. Measured against ghostpdl tags: gs9.18, gs9.19, gs9.20, gs9.21 carry the IDENTICAL profile (md5 e409cef13cd06f6b371f6cddc8e31fcf); ghostpdl-9.22, 9.26, 9.50, 9.53.3 and 10.06.0 carry a corrected profile (md5 27d2435a749ae91e9974bf7a109a03e5, illuminant 0000f6d6 00010000 0000d32d). The change landed at 9.22 (released 2017-10-04). So the renderer is a Ghostscript <= 9.21, which is every release in the 2011-2017 window and is consistent with the 2014 publication date; it also rules out the pages having been re-rendered with any post-2017 Ghostscript.

component_split.note: All 23 grayscale files carry the sRGB (not sGray) profile. Ghostscript's own jpeggray device writes 'Artifex Software sGray ICC Profile'; the observed combination is only produced by a downstream automatic gray detection that passes the source profile through, which is ImageMagick's behaviour.

excluded_encoders.ghostscript_jpeg_device_alone: emits IJG-standard Huffman tables; LP2 has optimised tables
excluded_encoders.imagemagick_alone_from_pdf: emits no Artifex ICC and forces 4:4:4 sampling at quality>=90; LP2 has an Artifex ICC and 4:2:0
excluded_encoders.python_pil: keeps 3 components on grayscale content, so it cannot produce the 23-page grayscale class

result.runes_are_typeset: 29/29 rune bitmaps recovered from the page images; uniform nominal height, constant stroke width, flat unserifed terminals, proportional widths 34-64 px. The runes are set from a font, not drawn.
result.platform_corroboration: 46 of 46 curated 3301 PGP-signed messages spanning 2012, 2013 and 2014 carry 'Version: GnuPG v1.4.11 (GNU/Linux)' - a single unchanged GNU/Linux signing environment across three years. GnuPG 1.4.11 was released 2010-10-18 and is the version packaged by Ubuntu 11.04 through 12.04 LTS (Debian wheezy shipped 1.4.12). This string is present in the raw archives but had never been analysed or turned into a finding.

coverage: All 58 LP2 page JPEGs, every marker, full DQT/DHT/ICC/JFIF/geometry/trailing-byte vector, byte-level. Prior work (corpus/G-forensics) covered pages 0-55 and recorded DQT sha1s only; this lane adds pages 56-57, the exact IJG quality, the Huffman-table classification, the ICC internals and release bound, the marker order and the trailing-byte check. 18 control renders across 9 pipelines x 2 source documents, plus 20 two-stage chain runs. 29/29 rune glyph bitmaps via the validated 96.93% reader. Ghostscript srgb.icc compared byte-exactly across ghostpdl tags 9.18-9.53.3 plus 10.06.0. 46/46 curated 3301 PGP messages checked for signer version. The archived onion7 index.html re-read in full, both copies.
